title: feat(connector-docusign): DocuSign eSignature connector app over the installer's OAuth client, sandbox first
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8QyKMa6E3hDZdbZ3S2VtCGM)_
Fixes #28277

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:新增私有元数据包 `packages/apps/connector-docusign`(仿 `connector-stripe`):DocuSign 电子签的 `openapi` 连接器(只含建信封、读信封、列状态变更三个操作)、`docusign_envelope` 对象及其列表视图、三个流程(发送、刷新单个信封、轮询状态变更)、上架清单、README 与测试。
- 为什么改:#28702 裁决 B 落地后(#28864/#28866/#28869),OAuth 客户端由每个部署的管理员自己注册并在连接时填入;本包用 `clientSource: 'installer'`,仓库里没有任何人的 clientId 或密钥,先走沙箱。
- 风险与回滚:不发布(`private: true`),不改平台代码、不改任何已发布键;回滚即 revert。实时沙箱往返未测(本容器网络策略拒绝 DocuSign 沙箱主机),欠验收运行。
- 先看:① `src/connectors/docusign.connector.ts` 的 `auth`(无 clientId、无 credentialRef);② `test/boot.test.ts` 的连接用例(管理员客户端 → 授权 URL → 回调换码);③ README 的 Credentials 与 Callbacks 两节。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/connector-app-docusign test`,预期 `objectstack validate` 通过且 2 个测试文件 27 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

A new npm-private metadata package, `@objectstack/connector-app-docusign` in `packages/apps/connector-docusign`, laid out like `packages/apps/connector-stripe`:

- `openapi/docusign-esignature.openapi.json`: DocuSign's eSignature document (`docusign/OpenAPI-Specifications` `esignature.rest.swagger-v2.1.json` at `858a3ae59b0edbc8beea4fa3a6d7fe803833dd68`, MIT, licence notice in `openapi/LICENSE`), converted from Swagger 2.0 and trimmed offline by `normalize-openapi` to `Envelopes_PostEnvelopes`, `Envelopes_GetEnvelope` and `Envelopes_GetEnvelopes`, with the 187 empty `consumes` lists filled (`--empty-consumes application/json`). The README's Provenance section records the command, the printed figures and the sha256 the listing test recomputes.
- `src/connectors/docusign.connector.ts`: a declarative `provider: 'openapi'` instance named `docusign`. `providerConfig.baseUrl` points it at the sandbox API host (`https://demo.docusign.net/restapi`), and `include` names the three operations. `auth` is `oauth2` `authorization_code` against `account-d.docusign.com` with `scopes: ['signature']` and `clientSource: 'installer'`. No `clientId` and no `credentialRef`: per ruling 6566728470 (letter B), the administrator of each deployment registers their own DocuSign integration key against that deployment's redirect URI and enters it on the connection. No key value is in the repository.
- `src/objects/docusign-envelope.object.ts` and `src/views/docusign-envelope.view.ts`: `docusign_envelope` with the two fields the skill eval names, `envelope_id` and `signature_status`, plus `email_subject` and `status_changed_at`, and one grid list view.
- `src/flows/docusign.flows.ts`: `docusign_send_envelope` (create and send one envelope, record it only when DocuSign accepted it), `docusign_get_envelope` (read one envelope, refresh its record), and `docusign_poll_status_changes` (list changes since `from_date`, copy each status onto its record; each update contained in a `try_catch`).
- `objectstack.manifest.json` with an `iconUrl` at the package's own `assets/icon.svg`, `README.md` (what it adds, credentials, running it, callbacks, limits, provenance), and `test/listing.test.ts` plus `test/boot.test.ts`.
- `pnpm-lock.yaml`, regenerated by `pnpm install` only. Besides the new importer, pnpm re-recorded `knex@3.3.0`'s optional peers (`mysql2`, `pg`, `tedious`, already in the lock) on its two importers. A `pnpm install --lockfile-only` on clean `origin/main` `f87239ae` changes nothing, while the same command with this importer added writes exactly this diff, so the peer re-resolution is pnpm's own response to the importer set changing.
- `packages/spec/src/system/constants/platform-object-names.test.ts`: the platform-object registry scan now leaves out installable app listings (a package root carrying `objectstack.manifest.json`), with two pin cases: the exclusion keys on the listing file and nothing broader (a lit control sees `docusign_envelope` and keeps it out), and an installable listing may declare no platform-prefixed object. The platform apps under `packages/apps` (`account`, `setup`, `studio`) carry no listing and stay scanned. Nothing is added to `PLATFORM_OBJECTS_BY_PACKAGE`; the file is outside spec's `files[]`, so `skip-changeset` still holds.

No changeset: the package is `private: true` and publishes nothing, so this PR carries `skip-changeset`.

## Why

#28277 is E4 batch 2 of #27293: DocuSign as the first declarative verification of the outbound OAuth path. Its blocker was the OAuth client. A packaged `clientId` works only on deployments whose callback the client's owner registered (report 6559204204). Ruling 6566728470 chose letter B, executed as #28864 (spec, `clientSource: 'installer'` on `ConnectorInstanceOAuth2AuthorizationCodeAuthSchema`, `packages/spec/src/shared/connector-auth.zod.ts`), #28866 (server: `installerClientOfBegin` and `keptInstallerClient` in `packages/services/service-automation/src/plugin.ts`, `takesInstallerClient` in `oauth2-grant/installer-client.ts`) and #28869 (the Console's Connect dialog). This package is the first listing on that shape.

## Tests

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/connector-app-docusign test` at head `d9a09f83`: `objectstack validate` exit 0 (1 object, 4 fields, 1 view, 3 flows, no warning), then vitest `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 27 passed (27)` (lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`). `pnpm --filter @objectstack/connector-app-docusign typecheck` exit 0.

- `test/listing.test.ts` (17): the manifest parses against `TemplateManifestSchema`, names the stack id and an owned http(s) icon; the connector's `auth` is exactly the installer-client shape and parses against `DeclarativeConnectorEntrySchema`; no file the package owns (outside DocuSign's document) carries a GUID-shaped value; the README's Credentials and Callbacks sections name the redirect URI path, the connection door and the poll flow; the packaged document's sha256 equals the README's record, it is OpenAPI 3.x with no security scheme, carries exactly the three included operations, and gives `Envelopes_PostEnvelopes` a JSON body.
- `test/boot.test.ts` (10): booted with `bootStack` against a fake DocuSign (the API through `ConnectorOpenApiPlugin`'s `fetchImpl`, the sandbox token endpoint through a `fetch` stub). Before a connect the instance is degraded "not connected" and the connection read answers `redirectUri`; a flow run fails `FLOW_FAILED` naming the connector and sends nothing; a connect naming no client is refused `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` naming the vendor registration step and the redirect URI; a connect with the administrator's integration key sends the browser to `account-d.docusign.com/oauth/auth` as that client (`scope=signature`, `code_challenge_method=S256`), the callback exchanges the code in HTTP Basic as that client, and the read shows the client without its secret; the instance then materializes with exactly the three actions; the three flows send the expected requests to `demo.docusign.net` as the bearer of the connection's token and write or refresh the record; a refused envelope writes no record.

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test:repo` at head `a7e2abd1`: 89 files and 1524 tests passed. Reverse verification: the pre-fix `platform-object-names.test.ts` fails 1 of 12 on this tree with the CI message; the fixed file passes 14 of 14.

No other ablation: the rest of the diff adds a package and changes no tested behaviour of existing code.

## Acceptance notes

- **Live sandbox round trip: NOT MEASURED, owed to the acceptance run.** `curl https://account-d.docusign.com/.well-known/openid-configuration` from this container: the egress proxy answered the CONNECT with `403 Forbidden` (demo.docusign.net and developers.docusign.com: no answer either). No integration key exists for this repository either, by design. The DocuSign console steps in the README follow DocuSign's documentation and say so.
- **Document depth.** The package ships the document at `--max-depth 0` (304,080 bytes, sha256 `b741ded5cfc4d0291d7f0e26559f8583f8c9a783f8711d8f9a98405cb27f7cb4`, 1,438 lines), as `connector-stripe` does. At the default depth of 2 the same run writes 553,922 bytes, sha256 `e1051eb4bbc381d879e979beac8cb64ead24531c93a19fc26e950a12d9fc961d` (the epic probe's hash, re-derived here independently), 4,737 lines, which takes this PR to 6,130 changed lines, over the 3,000-line human-merge threshold. At depth 0 the PR is 2,841 changed lines. The cost: `Envelopes_PostEnvelopes`'s body is described as DocuSign's envelope definition (type and description) rather than with its fields expanded. Switching is one normalizer run plus the README figures and one listing-test assertion.
- **Sandbox only.** Production DocuSign signs in at `account.docusign.com` and has a per-account API host (`base_uri` from `/oauth/userinfo`) that a packaged instance cannot name; the README's Limits section says production is not supported yet. No follow-up card is filed here.
- **Callbacks.** DocuSign Connect signs its own HMAC header, which the `api` flow door does not verify, so the app takes no Connect posts and polls instead (`docusign_poll_status_changes`); the README says so.
- **CEL map typing.** A CEL map literal's values share one type, so every string literal beside a variable read is wrapped in `dyn(…)` at every nesting level; `os validate` refused the first draft that wrapped only the top level (`expression-invalid`, "Map value uses wrong type"). The Stripe README already states the rule for the top level.

## Verification

- `node scripts/check-package-naming.mjs`: exit 0 (`129 workspace package(s)`, the `@objectstack/plugin-*` set exactly the 10 frozen names; this package is `@objectstack/connector-app-docusign`, beside `connector-app-stripe` and `connector-app-github`).
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` on this diff at head `a7e2abd1` derived 85 families; all 85 ran, every one exit 0 (four spec dist gates re-run after a spec build); `--ran` reconciliation: 85 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. Changed lines: 2923.
- `pnpm lint` (`eslint . --no-inline-config`): exit 0 (on `d9a09f83`; the patch round changes one test file).
- Every other CI family: this PR's check-runs.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (No spec change.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (Publishes nothing: `skip-changeset`.)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (Not touched.)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English (the 维护者速读 block excepted, by the dispatch contract).
